Fields.Name: Disable Param - Network Test
Fields.Description: Marks rows left out of the Network Test build.

Fields.Name: GPARAM Source Map ID
Fields.Description: Map whose GPARAM files are loaded instead of the map's own, as a number (m30_00 → 30000000). Only the area and block are used. A target in the overworld (m60 and others) makes the map use overworld GPARAM handling. -1: the map's own files.
